   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  August 10, 2026

Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. and Vice Chair Lopez led the Flag Salute.
Responding to roll call were Chair Ang, Vice Chair Lopez, Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner
Sanchez. Also present was Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior
Management Analyst, Marcus Dawal, Communications Specialist, Public Safety Commissioners
Patricia Hoskins and Kim Apodaca.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Lopez made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for
June 8, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responders Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda requested Commissioners’ approval of the 2026 invitation flyer, which will be distributed
via email. Approval was received. Mrs. Ocegueda will provide catering quotes at the next meeting. She
reported that Los Compadres does not offer catering services and that Angie’s is currently closed. She
will continue reaching out to other vendors to obtain a catering quote. Mrs. Ocegueda also provided
Commissioners with an updated cover letter and paper placemats for distribution to the schools. Mrs.
Ocegueda asked Commissioners if they would like to continue developing award criteria for next year’s
event. Commissioners agreed that they would like to continue working toward establishing formal award
criteria for the event. Mrs. Ocegueda also asked Commissioners if they would like to replace the current
raffle prizes with gift certificates from businesses highlighted through the Keepin’ It Norwalk Campaign.
Commissioners agreed to the proposed change to gift certificates.

Commissioners Appreciation Dinner

Commissioners continued discussions regarding the development of award criteria for the event.
Commissioners agreed that each Commission would conduct a confidential vote during its May meeting
to nominate an individual from its respective Commission for the award. The individual receiving the
most votes will be selected as the award recipient. Mrs. Ocegueda will develop a list of criteria for
Commissioners to consider when casting their votes and bring it to the Commission for their input.

Merchandise

Mrs. Ocegueda read an email from Levy sun with a response from the Finance Director.
Commissioners asked Mrs. Ocegueda to inform them on what steps they need to take to challenge the
Finance Director’s decision.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
August 10, 2026

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Mr. Dawal presented the “Keepin’ It Norwalk” campaign video, July Ice Cream edition, to the
Commissioners.

Communications Analytics

Mrs. Santa Ana presented monthly performance metrics across digital platforms. The Commission
received and filed the report.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda gave the Commission an update on the band survey they conducted at city events.
Mrs. Ocegueda informed them they have collected 431 responses, and of those responses 79% stated
they would like to see a Community Band put together, but only 28 of those responses have left contact
information for participation. The Commission still needs to collect another 169 surveys to complete the
necessary 600 count.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez detailed his experience hosting a Halloween Parade Foundation booth at the
National Night Out/Summer Concert event. Vice Chair Lopez detailed her experience at the National
Night Out/Summer Concert hosting the Commission’s booth and her trip to the OC Fair.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:08 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
